notes.title: Game breaking bug is Fixed!!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 
I just wanna thank you all for supporting my game Shine Within, It really means a lot to me to see you all play the game and enjoy your time with it. ːsteamhappyː

I've made a patch update to the game as I fixed a game-breaking bug that occurred right near the very end of the good ending route. (The issue was with the text overlapping causing the game to eventually crash. However, it should be all fixed now in this new update!! :D)

Once again I just wanna thank you all for the massive support within the last few days of release. It has been such an unreal experience to finally share my game with everyone which I'm highly grateful for this opportunity.

If you have encountered any bugs throughout your gameplay or just have any questions about the game in general please don't hesitate to ask me and I'll get back to you as soon as I can. 

You can also join the Shine Within Discord server where I'll be posting updates about the game as well! The link will be provided below!

Thanks everyone!!

- Ayetoons

Discord: https://discord.gg/zg2hzycDeD
